relevance.rationale: INFRA: file absent from HEAD and the working tree; exists only on origin/claude/upload-bib-papers-2026-05-19 (intake commit d8c9ca3bab). Recovered from git history. Identity confirmed from the document's own cover (arXiv:2101.08673v2, linear dynamics of wave functions in causal fermion systems, three authors) and matches the seeded key. One inline citation site: folio/quantum-observable-universe/observations/cfs-comparison-summary.md:1, 'Finster's causal fermion systems (CFS) [`finster2021`] provide a parallel unification programme.' NOT load-bearing, and the block's substantive claims are not in this document. Checked by full-text grep of the recovered PDF: 'causal action' 20 hits, but 'causal Lagrangian' 0, 'type II' 0, 'von Neumann' 0, 'unification' 0. The block asserts (i) 'Both embed as finite type II_1 factors', (ii) 'the Finster causal Lagrangian L_CFS(x,y) evaluates eigenvalue differences', (iii) 'L_CFS^(norm)(x,y) = G_2(x,y) - ||x.y||_1^2' — none of the three is supported by the cited document, which is a technical derivation of a dynamical wave equation and its Green's operators. The .ts manifest (cfs-comparison-summary.ts) lists four further sources (finster2022, finster2024, dappiaggi2024, biane1998) that never appear inline, so the load-bearing sources for (i)-(iii) are unattributed in the prose. Verdict tangential: the document is in an adjacent field but supplies no result this block consumes.

proposedActions.rationale: The three structural claims in the CFS comparison (type II_1 embedding, the causal-Lagrangian eigenvalue-difference form, and the G_2 - ||x.y||_1^2 decomposition) carry no inline source; the only inline citation is to a document that contains none of them. Record which of the .ts-listed sources actually backs each claim, or mark them as the folio's own reconstruction.
